5_t38Line109.stands: Yes: L109-114 is an endpoint graph, not segment enumeration. With stride 2 it unions endpoints that no drawn segment joins, inventing the edges that stitch the stubs to the bus; with stride 4 the endpoint count is 4/3. The electrical/geometric reading is 1/1 because the stub ends lie in the bus interior (T junctions). The doc's reframing (端点图 4/3、几何 1/1) is correct and is stronger than the original `[]` claim.
5_t38Line109.defect: the doc says `错在 L113/L114 的步长`. L113 is the point-registration loop and MUST stay i += 2; only L114's union stride becomes 4. Changing both breaks the structure: with both at 4 the +3V3 count is 1, not 4.
5_t38Line109.fix: change the sentence to `错在 L114 的 union 步长；L113 的顶点登记保持 i += 2`，and mirror the clarification in r3t1's t38Line109.site.

6_voidTable.lineRef: entry 11 cites `L2284`, which is the pre-edit line of the `[]` sentence (the correction now starts at L2286). Accurate as history; `原 L2284` would remove the ambiguity.

priorReviewErratum.right: geometric connectivity is 1/1 (T junctions: stub ends lie in the bus interior); only the endpoint graph is 4/3. The old `[]` was electrically right by accident (stride 2 stitched the pieces) and wrong by derivation.
priorReviewErratum.status: r11t4's void call on the doc's `[]` still stands; its geometric inference is superseded and must not be cited. This correction is r3t1's, and it is more accurate than r2t3/r11t4 on this point.

summary: The correction's core is right and verified independently: endpoint blocks 4/3, geometric 1/1, shapes 5x/4x, anchors and dx sets unchanged, coordinates and T-junction details exact. It also fixes my own overstatement that the nets were geometrically disconnected. Two defects keep it from sound: (a) the doc attributes the bug to `L113/L114` while L113 must stay at stride 2 — changing both turns 4 into 1 (mutation shown); (b) the affected/unaffected bookkeeping says 5 groups in one place and 8 in another, and `shapes` is stride-derived rather than connectivity-derived. Both are one-line fixes; after them the correction is sound.

The live half of r3t1's `活文档与 t31-dataset 两处一致` is self-reported; I re-derived from the snapshot and confirmed the snapshot numbers, and t53 independently confirms pages=2 / 55 wires, but I did not repeat their getAll probe.
